occupancyPanel.heading: Occupancy
occupancyPanel.gap: No source publishes an occupancy rate for this property, and there is no booking system behind this analysis that could compute one. No figure is shown. A plausible rate would be the most damaging number this product could invent: it is exactly what a competitor analysis gets read for.

relationship.heading: Hotel and residence
relationship.body: The hotel and the residence share a site but not their figures. 188 hotel rooms sit beside 656 residential units; the distances to water are kept apart because they measure two different walks from two different starting points: the residence to the sea, the hotel to the public beach (F-003). Combined, two evidenced figures would become one unevidenced one.

facts.intro: Every figure leads back to the source it came from. Where sources disagree, the disagreement sits on the number itself, not in a footnote.

distance.heading: Two distances, two reference points
distance.explanation: The residence is about 300 m from the sea; the hotel is about 1 km from the public beach. This is not a contradiction: they measure two different routes from two different starting points. Both values stay in separate fields and are never folded into one number.

reviews.intro: Each platform stands on its own, on its own scale.
reviews.noAverageNote: There is no overall score here. 4.6 out of 5 and 6.7 out of 10 cannot be combined. Any number that came out of it would have no source. The platforms sit beside each other, not on top of each other.

platform.syndicatedNote: The same score is served by other sites as well. That is not a second, independent rating. It is the same number with a different logo in front of it.

sentiment.heading: Rating distribution
sentiment.foldOnly: This platform publishes only a coarse three-way split.

verdict.heading: Both ends of the scale
verdict.intro: On the left the lowest-rated review this harvest recovered, on the right the highest. Equal width, equal type size. Both are derived from the same list; a view that shows only the good ones is not structurally possible here.
verdict.degenerate: Only one rated review is available. Two ends cannot be formed from it.
verdict.noRatings: None of the recovered reviews carries a readable rating.
verdict.unrated: {count} further reviews without a readable rating

quotes.heading: Every recovered review
quotes.intro: {count} reviews verbatim, unabridged and untranslated. The lowest and highest ratings come first.

unrecovered.heading: Booking platforms not recovered
unrecovered.intro: These platforms were requested and returned nothing usable. They are not missing. They were attempted, and the result is here. A Booking.com-produced score does exist nonetheless: it was found as a badge on a third-party page, not on booking.com itself. That is why the platform card above names the site that served it.

provenance.unresolvedNote: Deliberately unresolved. No mean, no median, no “most likely” pick. Any single number that came out of that would be an invention with a citation attached to it.

report.title: Public report
report.lead: The Azura World dataset. Same figures, same sources, no sign-in.
report.empty: No sourced data for this section.
report.shareDescription: The link opens the same state you are looking at now.

intake.title: Report damage
intake.lead: Report damage or a problem on the site. No account needed.
intake.privacy: Contact details are optional. Without them we cannot ask you anything back.
intake.locationHint: Block, floor, pool area, underground car park.
intake.descriptionHint: What you can see. Please leave other people's data out.
intake.contactHint: Email or phone, if you want us to be able to reply.
intake.storedBody: Write the number down. It is the only way to check the status later.
intake.unavailableBody: The report was not recorded and there is no number. Please send it again later.

track.title: Check status
track.lead: Enter the number from your report.
track.noResultBody: There is nothing on record for that number. Please check what you typed.

concierge.title: Azura Concierge
concierge.subtitle: Questions about the project. Answered from the sourced dataset only.
concierge.disclaimer: Answers come from the collected dataset and name their source. Where there is no source, it says so.
concierge.noAnswer: There is no sourced figure for that.

errors.rateLimited: Too many questions in a short time. Please wait a moment.
errors.refused: The assistant cannot carry out this request.

suggestions.one: How many units does the development have?
suggestions.two: What is on record about the developer?

concierge.refusalNote: The assistant answers only with statements that have a source. Where there is none, it says so instead of guessing.
concierge.notConfigured: The assistant is not set up in this environment. Everything else on the page still works.

login.title: Sign in
login.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Your input has been kept.

signup.title: Request access
signup.lead: Access requests are reviewed and granted manually.
signup.name: Name
signup.success: Request received. You will hear back by email.
signup.roleNotice: Access is granted by an administrator. The requester does not choose the role.
signup.emailHint: This is where the answer goes.
signup.companyHint: If you are asking on behalf of a company.
signup.reasonHint: What you need access for. At least 8 characters.
signup.unavailableBody: The request was not recorded. Please contact the management directly.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.lead: Your role does not permit this area.

qaMode.heading: Test mode without sign-in
qaMode.warning: In this environment a role can be taken on without a password. This is not a real sign-in and exists only for testing.
qaMode.failed: The role could not be applied.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: What data this application processes, and why.

mediaRights.title: Image rights
mediaRights.lead: Images come from publicly accessible sources and are shown with attribution only. Rights remain with their owners.
